card.name: Small words before Communist-state leaders
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, under, as, during) or the start of a name (F in Fidel, FNL) in text about Communist regimes such as North Korea, Cuba and Vietnam. The next word is likely a leader or country name.

modes.label: Linking word before regime term
modes.description: A short word like of, under or during in discussion of North Korea's leaders and ideology.
modes.example: What happens<< under>> Kim Jong-Il? Decline.

modes.label: Start of Cuban/Vietnamese name
modes.description: The first letter F of Fidel or FNL, in text on Cuba or Vietnam.
modes.example: As a result in 1959<< F>>idel Castro became Cuba’s new leader.

card.writes: It pushes toward North or Cuban-style names and away from Japan and Korea tokens.
card.plain: It fires on small words in history text about Communist states, just before a leader or country name.
